fields.description: Jomana introduces The Urban Edition’s contemporary architecture to Madinat Jumeirah Living. Its one- to four-bedroom apartments sit within a pedestrian-oriented neighbourhood with courtyards, parks and community facilities. Building-specific plans include both balcony homes and ground-floor homes with larger terraces.

overview: The reviewed Building 1 ground-floor examples have private terraces counted within total area. A larger terrace does not mean proportionately more enclosed living space; assess suite and outdoor components independently.
research.locationNote: Madinat Jumeirah Living in Dubai. Community retail and circulation routes are shared neighbourhood features; confirm the chosen home’s access rights and delivered facilities.

research.priceNote: The Meraas page is marked sold out and displays no numeric current starting price. No current developer quotation or available unit was verified; historical launch guides should not be treated as a present offer.
research.paymentNote: The original official calendar gives 20% booking; 10% August 2023; 10% February 2024; 10% August 2024; 10% February 2025; 10% August 2025; 30% May 2026 handover. These elapsed dates do not establish a new purchase schedule or prove that all units have handed over.
research.handoverNote: May 2026 is the original sheet’s estimated construction completion date. The own website’sJune 2026 update still describes finishing, approvals and handover preparations. A current completion certificate or selected-unit handover confirmation was not retrieved; the headline remains unset. Property Finder marks the project Ready and lists April 2026, whereas the developer’s older progress narrative describes handover preparations. That external status was not independently established for every home.
